title: Connecticut SBLR — Decision No. 5309 — City of Norwalk- First Taxing District
text:
STATE OF CONNECTICUT
LABOR DEPARTMENT
CONNECTICUT STATE BOARD OF LABOR RELATIONS
_______________________________________
In the matter of
City of Norwalk- First Taxing District
-and-
International Brotherhood of Electrical Workers,
Local 420
DECISION NO. 5309
CASE NO. ME-35223
DATE: February 28, 2024
DECISION
AND
CERTIFICATION OF REPRESENTATIVE
Pursuant to the Confirmation for Consent Election dated February 8, 2024, an election by secret
ballot was conducted on February 16, 2024 at Norwalk, Connecticut, under the supervision of the
Connecticut State Board of Labor Relations. The tally of ballots was as follows:
Number of Ballots Cast . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . …………. . . . . . . . . . . . . . 2_
Number of Ballots Counted . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . ………… . . . . 2_
Number of Votes IN FAVOR of representation………………………………………………. 2_
Number of Votes NOT IN FAVOR of representation………………………………………… 0_
Number of Blank Ballots . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . ………... . ..... 0_
Number of Void Ballots . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . ……………. . . . . … 0_
Number of Challenged Votes. . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . .................... 0_
Copies of the Report Upon Secret Ballot were duly served upon all parties. No exceptions to the
report or objections to the election were filed with the Board.
Since the parties have agreed that the unit is appropriate, the Board’s approval of the action
herein is not to be taken as a precedent as to what unit it would find appropriate in the absence of such an
agreement.
Therefore, by virtue of and pursuant to the power vested in the Connecticut State Board of Labor
Relations by the Municipal Employee Relations Act, it is hereby,
CERTIFIED, that International Brotherhood of Electrical Workers, Local 420 has been selected as the
representative for the purposes of collective bargaining by the majority of all Supervisory Water
Operations and Water Treatment Employees including Distribution Crew Chief, Chief Production
Operator and Chief Production Operator and Manager of Water Treatment Supply, excluding Guards. and
that said International Brotherhood of Electrical Workers, Local 420, is the exclusive representative of all
said employees for the purposes of collective bargaining with respect to wages, hours and other
conditions of employment.
